basic_details.job_title: ACTREC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: All U.G., P.G., or Super Specialty degrees must be recognized by the National Medical Commission. It is mandatory for all selected and appointed Senior Residents at ACTREC to be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,33,623/- p.m to Rs. 1,45,530/- p.m (Subject to Experience)

how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at the provided link.
Fill out the online application form completely in all respects.
Upload necessary documentary evidence in support of date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste, disability certificate, and NOC if applicable.
Pay the online application fee of Rs. 100/- using a Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.
Submit the online application form on or before 28.10.2026 by 05.30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).
important_instructions: Age and experience will be reckoned as on 28.10.2026. The upper age limit is 40 years, with relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates. Senior Residents must pay a Security / Caution Deposit of Rs. 1,33,623/- at the time of joining or have it deducted in five equal installments from their salary, which is refunded without interest after completion of the SRship. Residents may resign after completing five months of service by giving one month's notice (total 6 months service) to be eligible for a deposit refund; leaving without the required notice forfeits the last month's salary. Appointed candidates may be placed by rotation at ACTREC Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, Tata Memorial Hospital Mumbai, or any non-Mumbai centres including Sangrur, Mullanpur (Punjab), Varanasi, Visakhapatnam, Muzaffarpur, and Guwahati. Candidates working under Government or Autonomous bodies must upload an NOC and produce the original NOC to appear for the MCQ or interview. Shortlisted candidates will be given the option to attend the interview in person or request a link for an online interview. Result-awaited candidates must declare their degree passing on the day of the MCQ or VIVA to be allowed to appear.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration for the Senior Resident post ranges from Rs. 1,33,623/- p.m to Rs. 1,45,530/- p.m, subject to experience. Fellows may be provided sharing accommodation subject to availability, and hostel charges will be deducted every month from the stipend or salary. The post is tenured and non-permanent, running for a duration till 31.07.2027. Service as a Senior Resident at Tata Memorial Centre - ACTREC is considered as part of the P.G. Bond for those who completed MCh, DM, DNB, MS, or MD from Govt. & Municipal Medical Colleges in Maharashtra as per GR:MED.1013/NO.101/EDU 2 dated 07.06.2013.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ACTREC Senior Resident
content_sections.text: Visit the official application portal at the provided link. Fill out the online application form completely in all respects. Upload necessary documentary evidence in support of date of birth, qualifications, experience, caste, disability certificate, and NOC if applicable. Pay the online application fee of Rs. 100/- using a Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI. Submit the online application form on or before 28.10.2026 by 05.30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Documentary evidence of date of birth Educational qualification certificates and degree certificates Experience certificates Caste certificate (if claiming relaxation) Disability certificate (if applicable) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer for candidates working under Central/State Government, Autonomous Bodies, or Semi-Government Organizations

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Age and experience will be reckoned as on 28.10.2026. The upper age limit is 40 years, with relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates. Senior Residents must pay a Security / Caution Deposit of Rs. 1,33,623/- at the time of joining or have it deducted in five equal installments from their salary, which is refunded without interest after completion of the SRship. Residents may resign after completing five months of service by giving one month's notice (total 6 months service) to be eligible for a deposit refund; leaving without the required notice forfeits the last month's salary. Appointed candidates may be placed by rotation at ACTREC Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, Tata Memorial Hospital Mumbai, or any non-Mumbai centres including Sangrur, Mullanpur (Punjab), Varanasi, Visakhapatnam, Muzaffarpur, and Guwahati. Candidates working under Government or Autonomous bodies must upload an NOC and produce the original NOC to appear for the MCQ or interview. Shortlisted candidates will be given the option to attend the interview in person or request a link for an online interview. Result-awaited candidates must declare their degree passing on the day of the MCQ or VIVA to be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ACTREC Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 28.10.2026 till 05.30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold an MD or DNB in Anaesthesiology or an equivalent PG degree recognized by the National Medical Commission.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for ACTREC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as on 28.10.2026, with relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the consolidated salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration ranges from Rs. 1,33,623/- to Rs. 1,45,530/- subject to experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The online application fee is Rs. 100/-, payable via Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee refund policy?
faq.answer: The application fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, and duplication of fees will not be refunded.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises an MCQ examination, which is conducted if applicants exceed three times the vacancies, followed by a VIVA or interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is registration with a specific medical council mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes, it is mandatory for all selected and appointed Senior Residents to be registered with the Maharashtra Medical Council.

faq.question: Q9. Is this position permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a tenured non-permanent post for a duration running till 31.07.2027.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Candidates may be placed at ACTREC Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, Tata Memorial Hospital Mumbai, or any of the non-Mumbai centres by rotation as necessary.
